column1: # 001 Bialy plaszcz pod tronem - w ROT Barristan ma od startu wlasny rod u Daenerys (clan_sturgia_9): oba okna to wspomnienie, tylko relacje.

column15: {=ARM_KR_001_1_U}At the first court of the boy king, Joffrey told Ser Barristan Selmy that he was too old to guard a king and gave his place in the Kingsguard to Jaime Lannister. The old knight tore off his white cloak and threw it, with his sword, at the foot of the Iron Throne.
column16: {=ARM_KR_001_1_L}He walked out of the Red Keep that same day and cut down the gold cloaks sent to seize him at the gate. Where he rode no one at court can say, though some swear he took ship across the narrow sea.

column15: {=ARM_KR_001_2_U}Sailors from Qarth tell of a day in the great harbour when a stranger in the crowd came close to Daenerys Targaryen with death hidden in his hands. A broad old man with a white beard and a hardwood staff, who called himself Arstan and served as a squire, struck it aside first.
column16: {=ARM_KR_001_2_L}Only later did the queen learn who the old squire really was: Ser Barristan Selmy, once Lord Commander of the Kingsguard, who had crossed the sea to find the last of the dragons and judge her for himself.

column1: # 002 Wilk schodzi z Polnocy - oba okna przed ROT Riverlands Join the Fight; wariant a = Polnoca rzadzi ktos inny albo Greatjon nie zyje. Zbiorka przy Fosie Cailin (muster) dopiero od K2 - tu sam tekst.

column15: {=ARM_KR_002_1_U}The lords of the North ride into Winterfell with their levies at their backs. At the feast the Greatjon roars that he will not march behind lesser men and lays a hand on his sword, until Robb's direwolf knocks him to the floor and bites off two of his fingers.
column16: {=ARM_KR_002_1_L}The giant of Last Hearth only laughs at the blood on his hand, and from that night no man in the host stands closer to Robb Stark than the lord of the Umbers.

column15: {=ARM_KR_002_1a_U}The lords of the North ride in with their levies at their backs, called to war by {RULER}. In the hall the old quarrels over places in the line of march flare up again, and swords are half drawn before the lords remember whom they came to fight.
column16: {=ARM_KR_002_1a_L}By the end of the feast the bannermen agree on one thing at least: the North will answer for the blood of Eddard Stark, whoever leads it south.

column15: {=ARM_KR_002_2_U}When word of Lord Eddard's death reaches the host, the lords argue long into the night over which Baratheon to follow, Stannis or Renly. Then the Greatjon rises, says that no southron king will rule the North, lays his sword at Robb's feet and kneels.
column16: {=ARM_KR_002_2_L}One by one the others follow him and name Robb Stark their king, as the North had kings of its own before the dragons came. The shout goes up until the rafters ring.
column18: {=ARM_KR_002_2_Q}The hall falls silent and the lords look to you. What do you say?

column15: {=ARM_KR_002_2a_U}When word of Lord Eddard's death reaches the host, the lords argue long into the night over which Baratheon to follow. At last they decide that no southron king will rule them, and they kneel to {RULER} as the North once knelt to its own kings.
column16: {=ARM_KR_002_2a_L}The bannermen raise their swords and shout until the rafters ring. Whatever the south decides, the North has chosen to stand alone.

column1: # 003 Sansa na dworze Joffreya - brak termu bohater-w-osadzie: miejsce Sansy niesprawdzane (ROT NedEvent jej nie wiezi). Turniej w Przystani (tourney) w oknie 1.

column15: {=ARM_KR_003_1_U}King Joffrey takes Sansa Stark up onto the walls and makes her look at her father's head on a spike above the gate, and promises her that her brother's will soon join it. She thinks of pushing him off the walkway, and it is the Hound who steps between them.
column16: {=ARM_KR_003_1_L}Days later, at the tourney for the king's name day, a drunken knight called Ser Dontos falls from his horse and Joffrey wants him drowned in wine. Sansa saves the fool with a few clever words, and he never forgets it.

column15: {=ARM_KR_003_2_U}When word comes that Robb Stark has crushed a Lannister host at Oxcross, Joffrey has Sansa brought before the court and orders his Kingsguard to beat her in front of everyone, to punish the brother through the sister. Ser Meryn strikes and the court looks away.
column16: {=ARM_KR_003_2_L}Tyrion Lannister pushes through the crowd and stops it, scolding the king before his court, while the Hound throws his own white cloak around the girl. Sansa does not know what to make of either kindness.
column18: {=ARM_KR_003_2_Q}You stand among the courtiers in the yard. What do you do?

column15: {=ARM_KR_003_2a_U}When word comes that Robb Stark has crushed a Lannister host at Oxcross, Joffrey has Sansa brought before the court and orders his Kingsguard to beat her in front of everyone, to punish the brother through the sister. Ser Meryn strikes and the court looks away.
column16: {=ARM_KR_003_2a_L}It is the Hound who ends it, throwing his own white cloak around her and telling the king that the crowd has seen enough. No one else at court dares to say a word for the girl.

column1: # 004 Trupy wstaja w Czarnym Zamku - Dlugi Pazur Jon ma w ROT od startu (zestaw bat_bat_template_jon), wiec bez akcji item.

column15: {=ARM_KR_004_1_U}Rangers bring back two corpses found beyond the Wall, men of Benjen Stark's lost patrol, cold and pale with eyes gone blue. That night one of them rises, kills a guard and climbs to the Lord Commander's rooms with its dead hands reaching for Jeor Mormont.
column16: {=ARM_KR_004_1_L}Jon Snow throws a burning curtain over the thing and it goes up like old tallow. In thanks the Old Bear gives him Longclaw, the Valyrian sword of House Mormont, with a new wolf's head pommel.

column1: # 005 Stos khala Drogo - opowiesc zza morza; done:NedEvent obowiazkowe (wojny Essos ruszaja od kalendarza jeszcze w prologu).

column15: {=ARM_KR_005_1_U}Merchants from Pentos tell a tale that grows with every telling. Khal Drogo took a small wound in a quarrel, it festered and he fell from his horse. A witch's blood magic kept his body alive but not his mind, and his great khalasar broke apart.
column16: {=ARM_KR_005_1_L}His widow, Daenerys Targaryen, walked into the flames of his pyre with three stone eggs, and at dawn she rose from the ashes unburnt with three living dragons. The khals of the grass sea say no woman will ever rule them.

column1: # 006 Czerwona kometa - raz na kampanie; tekst wedlug miejsca gracza (warianty: Polnoc, ziemie korony, Smocza Skala, Mur, Zelazne Wyspy, Essos).

column15: {=ARM_KR_006_1_U}A comet appears in the sky, red as fresh blood, its long tail trailing across the stars. It burns all night and can be seen even by day. Every road and every village has its own reading of the sign, and the septons are kept busy with frightened questions.
column16: {=ARM_KR_006_1_L}Some say it heralds the end of summer, some say a new king, others that it is the colour of the war already begun. No one agrees on anything, except that the gods have sent it for a reason.

column14: {=ARM_KR_006_1a_T}A Bloody Sword in the Northern Sky
column15: {=ARM_KR_006_1a_U}In the North men look up at the comet and see the blood of Eddard Stark. Old women in the villages say the gods of the wood are calling for vengeance, and the smallfolk take it as a sign that their young lord will march south and win.
column16: {=ARM_KR_006_1a_L}In the alehouses of Winterfell the soldiers call it a bloodied sword hanging over the realm, and every one of them means to be among those who wield it.

column15: {=ARM_KR_006_1b_U}In King's Landing the courtiers call the comet a herald of the boy king's reign, red and gold like the banners of his mother's house. Criers in the markets shout that the heavens themselves salute King Joffrey.
column16: {=ARM_KR_006_1b_L}In the alleys of Flea Bottom the poor whisper something else: that the comet is the colour of blood and fire, and that the city will see plenty of both before the year is out.

column15: {=ARM_KR_006_1c_U}On Dragonstone the red priestess Melisandre tells Stannis Baratheon that the comet is his sign, a flame sent by the Lord of Light. It marks the coming of a hero reborn, she says, and the hour for a true king to draw his burning sword.
column16: {=ARM_KR_006_1c_L}Old Maester Cressen thinks the comet means only death and fears what the red woman is making of his lord. He is not the only one in the castle who looks at the sky and prays to the Seven in silence.

column15: {=ARM_KR_006_1d_U}On the Wall the black brothers watch the comet rise over the haunted forest. Some say it brings luck for the great ranging the Lord Commander is planning, others see a warning of something coming down from the north.
column16: {=ARM_KR_006_1d_L}The wildlings beyond the Wall have their own name for it and take it as a sign that the time has come to move south. Rangers who return report more empty villages than ever before.

column15: {=ARM_KR_006_1e_U}On the Iron Islands the priests of the Drowned God cry that the comet is a sign for the ironborn, the red of their god's anger blown across the heavens to call them back to the Old Way of reaving and raiding.
column16: {=ARM_KR_006_1e_L}Lord Balon Greyjoy lets them preach. In the halls of Pyke the captains sharpen their axes and count their longships, and every man of them knows which shore lies nearest and least defended.

column15: {=ARM_KR_006_1f_U}Across the narrow sea the comet is called the bleeding star. In the camps of the Dothraki it is a portent of a khal's death, and in the free cities the priests of the red god say it heralds a hero reborn in flame.
column16: {=ARM_KR_006_1f_L}Those who follow Daenerys Targaryen say the comet is hers. It appeared, they swear, on the night her dragons first cried out, and it points the way west, toward the throne of her fathers.

column1: # 007 Plonacy bogowie i list Stannisa - Cressena nie ma w grze (tylko tekst); okno 2 przed wojna Smoczej Skaly z korona z ROT (ok. 585).

column15: {=ARM_KR_007_1_U}Old Maester Cressen tries to poison Melisandre with a cup of wine at the feast, but the red priestess drinks and lives, and it is the maester who dies. Soon after, Stannis has the statues of the Seven dragged from the sept of Dragonstone and burned on the beach.
column16: {=ARM_KR_007_1_L}Before his knights and bannermen Stannis draws a burning sword from the fire, while the red woman names him a hero reborn. Not every lord of the narrow sea is glad to see the Seven of his fathers go up in smoke.

column14: {=ARM_KR_007_2_T}A Letter Sealed with a Crowned Stag
column15: {=ARM_KR_007_2_U}Ravens fly from Dragonstone to every lord of the Seven Kingdoms, each bearing the same letter. Stannis Baratheon declares that Joffrey, Myrcella and Tommen are not the children of King Robert, but bastards born of Queen Cersei and her brother Jaime.
column16: {=ARM_KR_007_2_L}By right of blood, the letter says, the Iron Throne belongs to Stannis alone. In King's Landing the queen has the letters burned, but the words are already in every tavern from the Wall to Dorne.

column15: {=ARM_KR_008_1_U}Yoren of the Night's Watch smuggles Arya Stark out of King's Landing among his new recruits, her hair hacked short and her name changed to Arry. On the same wagons rides Gendry, a smith's apprentice whom the queen's men are hunting for reasons of their own.
column16: {=ARM_KR_008_1_L}By the God's Eye Ser Amory Lorch and his riders fall on the camp. Yoren dies fighting and the children are dragged off to Harrenhal, where no one guesses that the skinny boy is a daughter of Winterfell.

column15: {=ARM_KR_008_1a_U}A recruiter of the Night's Watch smuggles Arya Stark out of King's Landing among his new recruits, her hair hacked short and her name changed to Arry. On the same wagons rides Gendry, a smith's apprentice whom the queen's men are hunting.
column16: {=ARM_KR_008_1a_L}By the God's Eye Ser Amory Lorch and his riders fall on the camp and drag the children off to Harrenhal, where no one guesses that the skinny boy is a daughter of Winterfell.

column15: {=ARM_KR_008_2_U}In Harrenhal Arya hides as a serving girl. A strange prisoner she once saved from the fire, Jaqen H'ghar, owes her three lives, and he pays the debt with three deaths of her choosing. When the siege of the castle ends in blood and confusion, she knows it is time to go.
column16: {=ARM_KR_008_2_L}One night she kills a guard at the postern, steals three horses and rides out with Gendry and Hot Pie, the baker's boy. Behind them the great burnt towers fade into the rain, and ahead lies the long road home.

column15: {=ARM_KR_008_2a_U}In Harrenhal Arya hides as a serving girl. Jaqen H'ghar owes her three lives and pays with three deaths, and at her word he helps northern captives open the castle to Roose Bolton. Soon she is pouring wine for the Lord of the Dreadfort, who never asks her name.
column16: {=ARM_KR_008_2a_L}One night she kills a guard at the postern, steals three horses and rides out with Gendry and Hot Pie, the baker's boy. Behind them the great burnt towers fade into the rain, and ahead lies the long road home.

column1: # 009 Reka sprzata stolice - po scenie 901; Slynta i Pycelle (notabl) tylko w tekscie; Bywater = ROTwanderer25 (korona, prolog).

column15: {=ARM_KR_009_1_U}The new Hand wastes no time. Janos Slynt, who betrayed Lord Eddard for gold, is stripped of the City Watch and sent to take the black, his captains with him. The gold cloaks go to Ser Jacelyn Bywater, a hard man who lost a hand at Pyke and wears one of iron.
column16: {=ARM_KR_009_1_L}Bronn takes charge of the sellswords, and for the first time in months the streets of King's Landing feel watched. Queen Cersei is furious that her brother acted without asking her.

column15: {=ARM_KR_009_2_U}Tyrion suspects that someone on the small council carries his every word to his sister. He tells Grand Maester Pycelle, Lord Varys and Littlefinger three different plans for Princess Myrcella's marriage, and waits to see which tale reaches the queen.
column16: {=ARM_KR_009_2_L}Cersei rages about Dorne, and Dorne was what he told Pycelle. The old maester is dragged to the black cells with his beard shorn off, and Tyrion trusts Varys a little more and Littlefinger a little less.

column1: # 010 Czerwone Pustkowie i Dom Niesmiertelnych - opowiesc kupcow (w ROT Daenerys jest juz w Zatoce); okno 2 w czasie wojny Qarthu z Targaryenami albo najpozniej od dnia 300 (wariant pokoju).

column15: {=ARM_KR_010_1_U}Traders from Qarth tell how the young Targaryen queen came out of the red waste with a ragged band of the old, the sick and freed slaves, on horses that were dying under them, and three dragons no bigger than cats riding on her shoulders and her cart.
column16: {=ARM_KR_010_1_L}The Pureborn, the merchant princes and the warlocks of Qarth all came out to see the wonder. Each of them offered her gifts, and each of them, men said, wanted only one thing in return: her dragons.

column15: {=ARM_KR_010_2_U}The warlocks of Qarth invited Daenerys into the House of the Undying, a tower without windows, promising her truth and visions. They meant to keep her there forever and feed on her dragons, but little Drogon breathed fire on the withered ones and the palace burned.
column16: {=ARM_KR_010_2_L}The queen fled Qarth soon after, with a price on her head from the warlocks and the merchant princes. The great city has hated her ever since, and now its galleys carry that hatred to war against her.

column15: {=ARM_KR_010_2a_U}The warlocks of Qarth invited Daenerys into the House of the Undying, a tower without windows, promising her truth and visions. They meant to keep her there forever and feed on her dragons, but little Drogon breathed fire on the withered ones and the palace burned.
column16: {=ARM_KR_010_2a_L}The queen fled Qarth soon after with a price on her head. Its merchants still speak her name with hatred, but for now the great city prefers counting its gold to making war on dragons.

column15: {=ARM_KR_011_1_U}Roose Bolton leads the foot of the North down the kingsroad against Tywin Lannister's host on the Green Fork. The northmen are beaten, but they hold the lions long enough while Robb Stark and his horse slip away west toward the Twins.
column16: {=ARM_KR_011_1_L}Tyrion fights his first battle in the front rank of his hill tribesmen, and Shagga son of Dolf comes out of it swearing that the little lord has the heart of a giant. Lord Tywin wins the field, but not the campaign.

column15: {=ARM_KR_011_1a_U}Roose Bolton leads the foot of the North down the kingsroad against Tywin Lannister's host on the Green Fork. The northmen are beaten, but they hold the lions long enough while Robb Stark and his horse slip away west toward the Twins.
column16: {=ARM_KR_011_1a_L}Wild clansmen from the Mountains of the Moon fight in the lions' front rank and the field is Tywin's by dusk. But the young wolf's horsemen are already gone, and the victory proves hollow.

column1: # 012 Przeprawa przez Blizniaki - relacja Waldera z Robbem rosnie (zeby nr 31 mialo z czego spasc); wybor dla gracza w armii, wasala Polnocy (zloto gracz -> Walder).

column15: {=ARM_KR_012_1_U}Robb Stark's host needs the bridge at the Twins, and old Walder Frey, Lord of the Crossing, sells nothing cheap. Lady Catelyn rides into his castle alone and bargains for a day beneath the insults of the old man and the stares of his countless sons.
column16: {=ARM_KR_012_1_L}The price is high: Robb will wed one of Lord Walder's daughters, Arya will be promised to one of his sons, and Frey swords will march with the king. Robb agrees without a pause, and the host crosses the river that night.
column18: {=ARM_KR_012_1_Q}The Freys count every coin and every sword. Will you add to the price?

column15: {=ARM_KR_901_1_U}Lord Tywin will not leave the war to sit at court, so he sends his younger son instead. Tyrion Lannister is to rule in his name as Hand of the King, keep the boy king in check and stop the queen from making things worse than they already are.
column16: {=ARM_KR_901_1_L}Tyrion rides through the city gates with Bronn at his side and a band of wild hill tribesmen behind him. In the Red Keep his sister greets him with all the warmth she might show the plague.
